description:
Employment Type: Contract
   City: Richardson 
 State: Texas
 Status: Accepting Candidates
 Description: • Development and maintenance of java integration adapters communicating with network elements. Become an expert on the network discovery and reconciliation tool
 • Work with Business Analysts to understand requirements for new adapter and data development
 • Support System and UAT testing
 • Advise senior leadership, business stakeholders, and application developers on requirements, design, and development for the platform.
 • Quickly learn Frontiers business processes surrounding network inventory, network provisioning, service qualification, and facility assignment
 • Ability to deliver projects and meet deadlines in a fast paced environment, attend and contribute to internal technical meetings
 • Successful candidate will have high standards for service to users/customers and be team oriented.
 Software Skills:
 • Web Skills: basic HTML, XML, JavaScript, and SOAP/REST web services
 • Language/Framework: Java, Eclipse, Application Servers (Weblogic), SQL
 • Databases: Oracle
 • SDLC: Agile-Scrum, Iterative, Waterfall
 • Toolsets (experience with one or more): Hawkeye, DBU, X-Analysis, Rational Developer
 Required Skills:
 • Software development experience with Java & SQL
 • Excellent Telecom domain knowledge
 • Excellent OSS domain knowledge, particularly network planning and network & service inventory management
 • Ability to work with customers, sales, support, product management, partners and in a virtual team
 • Experience with multiple network interface technologies - e.g. SNMP, TL1, CORBA
 • Experience with J2EE and other general programming technologies - e.g. SOAP, JMS, XML
 • Experience with Oracle Design Studio and Eclipse IDE
 • Familiarity with UNIX/Linux systems, Oracle Database and Middleware
 • Bachelors degree in relevant discipline or 4 years of experience
 • Expertise with system integration using APIs, web services, java, XML and other integration technologies
 • Experience interfacing with network element management systems.
 • Strong Analytical and Problem solving skills
 • Excellent written, verbal presentation, and organizational communication skills
 • Organization and time management skills
  
 



 Need immediately, please call Rushi on 408 913 1559
